title.en: Fix the Count and Catch a New Omission

brief.zh: 控制柜维修需要两根电线、一根保险丝和一块电路板。每次收到新清单，都把三项重新检查一遍。
brief.en: The control cabinet repair needs two wires, one fuse, and one circuit board. Recheck all three items each time a new manifest arrives.

concept.zh: 后续草稿会保留很多之前的行，也可能遗漏另一条正确的记录。
concept.en: A revised draft can preserve many earlier rows and still omit one that used to be correct.

hints.zh: 第一轮和第二轮错的可能是不同物品。先标记当前轮的差异，再修改。
hints.en: Different items may be wrong in the first and second rounds. Mark the current discrepancies before sending a correction.

zh: 准备 2 件电线、1 件保险丝、1 块电路板。
电线改为 2 根。保留其他项目。
保险丝改为 1 根。保留其他项目。
en: Pack 2 wires, 1 fuse, and 1 circuit board.
Set wires to 2. Keep the other entries.
Set fuses to 1. Keep the other entries.
